features.name: Amidst All This Commotion…
features.text: If a creature dies while you Sneak Attack them, you may turn Invisible until you attack again or until the beginning of your next turn.
features.manualNote: When a creature you Sneak Attack dies, mark yourself Invisible by hand; remove it when you attack again or at the beginning of your next turn.

features.name: Leave No Trace
features.text: Advantage on Stealth checks when you are at full health.

features.name: Cunning Strike
features.text: Deal +2×INT damage whenever you crit.

features.name: Professional Skulker
features.text: Gain a climbing Speed and advantage on Stealth checks (replaces Leave No Trace).
features.manualNote: You have a climbing Speed (the page gives no number; the sheet does not track it).

source.note: The climbing Speed has no printed value (presumably equal to your Speed); kept as text. Open rules question.

features.name: KILL
features.text: When you Sneak Attack an enemy with fewer max HP than you, it dies.
features.manualNote: When you Sneak Attack an enemy whose max HP is lower than yours, it dies (GM confirms).

features.name: Low Blow
features.text:
When you Sneak Attack a creature not already Taunted by you, you may spend 1 additional action to roll 1d4. They are:
1. Taunted by you for the rest of this encounter.
2. Knocked Prone, then Taunted by you for the rest of this encounter.
3. Dazed, then Taunted by you for the rest of this encounter.
4. Incapacitated until the end of the next hero’s turn.

action.name: Low Blow
action.text:
When you Sneak Attack a creature not already Taunted by you, you may spend 1 additional action to roll 1d4. They are:
1. Taunted by you for the rest of this encounter.
2. Knocked Prone, then Taunted by you for the rest of this encounter.
3. Dazed, then Taunted by you for the rest of this encounter.
4. Incapacitated until the end of the next hero’s turn.

features.manualNote: Use only right after a Sneak Attack on a creature not already Taunted by you. Apply the rolled result (Taunted, Prone, Dazed or Incapacitated) to the target by hand.

features.name: Sweet Talk
features.text: You may gain advantage on all Influence checks with NPCs you’ve just met for the first time. This lasts until you fail an Influence check with them or until you meet a 2nd time. You have disadvantage on Influence checks with them after you use this ability (until you get back on their good side).

when.situation: Influence check with an NPC you’ve just met for the first time (until you fail one with them or meet a 2nd time)

features.manualNote: Track per NPC when the advantage ends, and apply disadvantage on later Influence checks with that NPC by hand (until you get back on their good side).

features.name: Pocket Sand
features.text: (2/encounter—you’ve got to collect more sand!) When you Defend against an adjacent creature, Blind the attacker until the start of their next turn and force them to reroll the attack (Blind creatures attack with disadvantage).

action.name: Pocket Sand
action.text: (2/encounter—you’ve got to collect more sand!) When you Defend against an adjacent creature, Blind the attacker until the start of their next turn and force them to reroll the attack (Blind creatures attack with disadvantage).

features.manualNote: Use when you Defend against an adjacent creature: mark the attacker Blinded until the start of its next turn and have the GM reroll the attack.

source.note: Used as part of Defend; no extra action cost printed, so `actions` is omitted.

features.name: Escape Plan
features.text: (1/Safe Rest) When you would drop to 0 HP or gain a Wound, you don’t. Instead, you turn Invisible for 1 minute or until you attack.

action.name: Escape Plan
action.text: (1/Safe Rest) When you would drop to 0 HP or gain a Wound, you don’t. Instead, you turn Invisible for 1 minute or until you attack.

features.manualNote: Undo the drop to 0 HP or the Wound by hand and mark yourself Invisible (1 minute or until you attack).

features.name: Heads I Win, Tails You Lose
features.text: (1/encounter) Attacks you make this round don’t miss, you crit on 1 less than normally needed, and you gain LVL temp HP.

action.name: Heads I Win, Tails You Lose
action.text: (1/encounter) Attacks you make this round don’t miss, you crit on 1 less than normally needed, and you gain LVL temp HP.

features.manualNote: For this round, treat misses as hits and crit on 1 less than normal; add LVL temp HP by hand.

source.note: No action cost printed, so `actions` is omitted.

name: Tools of the Serpent
tagline: You have harnessed the terrible fangs of nature to her deadly array of poisons. Choose this subclass if you want to debilitate your foes with venom and viciousness.

features.name: Viper’s Kiss
features.text: Creatures you damage become Poisoned until the end of their next turn. Creatures Poisoned this way are also Distracted.
features.manualNote: Mark creatures you damage as Poisoned (and Distracted) until the end of their next turn by hand.

features.name: I’ve Tried This One Before
features.text: You have advantage on saves against poison. Additionally, you can identify any poison you inspect.
features.manualNote: Identifying poisons you inspect is handled with the GM.

features.name: Noxious Cloud
features.text: (1/encounter, Reach 4) Action: Enemies in a 2×2 area take INT d6 damage (ignoring armor) and become Poisoned. Creatures already Poisoned are also Dazed.

action.name: Noxious Cloud
action.text: (1/encounter, Reach 4) Action: Enemies in a 2×2 area take INT d6 damage (ignoring armor) and become Poisoned. Creatures already Poisoned are also Dazed.

features.manualNote: Mark enemies in the 2×2 area Poisoned (already Poisoned ones also Dazed) by hand.

features.name: Cruel Dose
features.text: Creatures Poisoned by you are also Slowed and their attack Range is halved.
features.manualNote: Mark creatures you Poison as Slowed too; their attack Range is halved (GM applies).

features.name: Volatile Toxins
features.text: Noxious Cloud can be used twice each encounter. Whenever a creature Poisoned by you dies, their body erupts into a Noxious Cloud.
features.manualNote: Noxious Cloud's limit becomes 2/encounter: track the second use by hand. When a creature you Poisoned dies, resolve a Noxious Cloud centred on it.

name: Tools of the Gambler
tagline: Trust me—this time it’s a SURE THING. Choose this subclass if you want to risk it all with dangerous plays and walk the line of ruin.

features.name: All In
features.text: When you Sneak Attack, you may go All In: Roll a single All In die; if it rolls higher than average, maximize ALL of your Sneak Attack dice; otherwise minimize them.
features.manualNote: The page does not name the All In die's size or define "average". Until confirmed, roll the die your GM agrees on and maximize or minimize your Sneak Attack dice by hand.

source.note: Text verified against the image, but the All In die size and the meaning of "higher than average" are not stated (presumably one Sneak Attack die vs. its average). Open rules question.

features.name: That Was Just a Practice Roll
features.text: (1/encounter) You may reroll ANY die.

option.label: That Was Just a Practice Roll

features.manualNote: Rerolling a die that isn't on your sheet (an ally's or the GM's) is done by hand; spend the use on the sheet.

features.name: It’s All Fun and Games
features.text: If you’re caught cheating at a game, competition, or wager, you gain advantage on skill checks to get out of the consequences.

when.situation: Getting out of the consequences of being caught cheating at a game, competition, or wager

features.name: Pocket Aces!
features.text: (1/Safe Rest) You can set a friendly creature’s Initiative roll to 20.

action.name: Pocket Aces!
action.text: (1/Safe Rest) You can set a friendly creature’s Initiative roll to 20.

features.manualNote: Tell the friendly creature to set its Initiative roll to 20.

source.note: No action cost printed, so `actions` is omitted.

features.name: Double or Nothing!
features.text: When you lose your “All In” roll, you may try once more. If you succeed, add 1 additional maximized Sneak Attack die. If you fail, your attack misses entirely and your turn ends.
features.manualNote: Reroll the All In die once. Success: add 1 extra maximized Sneak Attack die. Failure: the attack misses and your turn ends.

source.note: Text verified. Depends on the All In die, whose size and “average” are an open rules question (see All In).

features.name: Play the Odds
features.text: (1/round) When a creature hits you, you may force them to reroll their Primary Die. If the roll is lower, the attack misses; otherwise, it crits.

action.name: Play the Odds
action.text: (1/round) When a creature hits you, you may force them to reroll their Primary Die. If the roll is lower, the attack misses; otherwise, it crits.

features.manualNote: The GM rerolls the attacker's Primary Die: lower misses, otherwise it crits.

source.note: No action cost printed, so `actions` is omitted.

features.name: Odds Maker
features.text: You may use That Was Just a Practice Roll 2/encounter and you may instead change the die to any other face.
features.manualNote: That Was Just a Practice Roll becomes 2/encounter (track the second use by hand) and may set the die to any other face instead of rerolling.

source.note: “That Was Just a Practice Roll” is italic on the page; the sheet can't change that feature's limit, so this stays text.

features.name: Honorseeker
features.text:
You give up Sneak Attack, Vicious Opportunist, Underhanded Abilities, and Twist the Blade, in exchange gain:
• Honorable Gambits. For every Underhanded Ability you would have (except for your Old Habits…), choose an Honorable Gambit instead.
features.manualNote: Twist the Blade is replaced by Even the Odds (level 5) and Supreme Execution by Supreme Underdog (level 20). Each Underhanded Ability choice offers Honorable Gambits instead (except Old Habits…).

source.note: Worthy Underdog and Tenacious Fighter bullets of this block are separate features. Sneak Attack scaling: Tenacious Fighter uses var.sneakAttack, so the engine must keep applying the replaced Sneak Attack features' setVar (or the rules owner must decide another way) for its die to grow. Printed as an unlabelled block above the level rows; placed at level 3, when the subclass is taken.

features.name: Worthy Underdog
features.text: When enemies have The Upper Hand, attacks miss you on 2 or less.
features.manualNote: The Upper Hand. Whenever there are more of them adjacent to you than allies. While enemies have it, their attacks against you miss on a Primary Die of 2 or less (GM applies).

source.note: Printed as an unlabelled block above the level rows; placed at level 3, when the subclass is taken.

features.name: Tenacious Fighter
features.text: (1/turn) When you HIT an enemy that has The Upper Hand you may change the Primary Die roll to whatever you like and deal +1d6 damage (this increases as your Sneak Attack dice would).

when.situation: You hit an enemy that has The Upper Hand
You hit an enemy that has The Upper Hand (same use as Tenacious Fighter)

features.manualNote: The Upper Hand. Whenever there are more of them adjacent to you than allies. Pick the new Primary Die face; the extra damage die is +1d6, growing as Sneak Attack would (1d8 from level 3).

source.note: Text verified. Interpretation: the +1d6 grows on the Sneak Attack schedule (so 1d8 at level 3, via var.sneakAttack), and the damage option shares the one 1/turn use with the Primary Die change (limit is only on the attack option). Open rules question. Printed as an unlabelled block above the level rows; placed at level 3, when the subclass is taken.

features.name: Prove Your Worth!
features.text: (Reach 12, 1/turn) Taunt an enemy for free (lasts until they damage you). Gain DEX damage reduction vs enemies Taunted by you.

action.name: Prove Your Worth!
action.text: (Reach 12, 1/turn) Taunt an enemy for free (lasts until they damage you). Gain DEX damage reduction vs enemies Taunted by you.

features.manualNote: Track the Taunt by hand (it lasts until that enemy damages you) and subtract DEX from damage those Taunted enemies deal to you.

features.name: Even the Odds
features.text: When attacking or being attacked by an enemy with The Upper Hand, you may spend an action to change a die up or down 1 face (replaces Twist the Blade and improves as it would).

action.name: Even the Odds
action.text: When attacking or being attacked by an enemy with The Upper Hand, you may spend an action to change a die up or down 1 face (replaces Twist the Blade and improves as it would).

features.manualNote: Change the die by 1 face by hand. From level 13 (as Twist the Blade (2) would): (1/turn) you can use Even the Odds for free.

source.note: Text verified. Interpretation: “improves as it would” means Twist the Blade (2) at level 13 also applies, so it is replaced too and its improvement ((1/turn) for free) is in the manualNote. Which dice count (any die in the attack?) is not stated. Open rules question.

features.name: Old Habits…
features.text: Choose 1 Underhanded Ability.

features.name: Right Where I Want You
features.text: You have advantage on attacks and +10 Defense as long as enemies have The Upper Hand.
features.manualNote: The Upper Hand. Whenever there are more of them adjacent to you than allies. Turn on the toggles while it applies.

features.name: Turn the Tables
features.text: When an enemy with The Upper Hand misses you in melee, you may spend an action attacking them in return.

action.name: Turn the Tables
action.text: When an enemy with The Upper Hand misses you in melee, you may spend an action attacking them in return.

features.manualNote: Make your attack against that enemy by hand.

features.name: Supreme Underdog
features.text: (Replaces Supreme Execution…) You take 10 less damage from all attacks by creatures with The Upper Hand.

choice.prompt: +1 to any 2 of your stats (kept from Supreme Execution, RQ-022).

features.manualNote: Subtract 10 from damage dealt to you by attacks from creatures with The Upper Hand.

source.note: RQ-022: the book doesn't say whether replacing Supreme Execution also removes its “+1 to any 2 of your stats”; the sheet keeps the stat increase.

cheat.honorable-gambits.name: Deft Parry
cheat.honorable-gambits.text: You take –INT damage from enemies while they have The Upper Hand.
cheat.honorable-gambits.manualNote: Subtract INT from damage enemies deal to you while they have The Upper Hand.

cheat.honorable-gambits.name: Down, Not Out!
cheat.honorable-gambits.text: While Dying, reduce all Primary Dice rolled against you by 1, and you gain advantage on saves.
cheat.honorable-gambits.manualNote: While Dying, the GM reduces Primary Dice rolled against you by 1.

cheat.honorable-gambits.name: Frightful Confidence
cheat.honorable-gambits.text: While Bloodied, when you are attacked with advantage their lowest die is Primary.
cheat.honorable-gambits.manualNote: While Bloodied, remind the GM: attacks with advantage against you use their lowest die as Primary.

cheat.honorable-gambits.name: Mark of Deflection
cheat.honorable-gambits.text: If you’ve already Defended this round, attacks against you are rolled with disadvantage.
cheat.honorable-gambits.manualNote: After you Defend, remind the GM that attacks against you this round are rolled with disadvantage.

cheat.honorable-gambits.name: Nowhere to Flee!
cheat.honorable-gambits.text: Gain +INT Speed when moving toward enemies Taunted by you. Your Opportunity Attacks also Slow Medium or smaller targets on hit.

when.situation: Moving toward enemies Taunted by you

cheat.honorable-gambits.manualNote: Mark Medium or smaller targets hit by your Opportunity Attacks as Slowed.

cheat.honorable-gambits.name: Redemption Arc
cheat.honorable-gambits.text: Reaction (when an enemy with The Upper Hand attacks an ally): You may first Taunt them (the attack is rolled again, choose either result), this lasts until the end of their next turn.

action.name: Redemption Arc
action.text: Reaction (when an enemy with The Upper Hand attacks an ally): You may first Taunt them (the attack is rolled again, choose either result), this lasts until the end of their next turn.

cheat.honorable-gambits.manualNote: Mark the enemy Taunted until the end of its next turn; the GM rolls the attack again and you choose either result.

source.note: No action cost printed for this Reaction, so `actions` is omitted.

cheat.honorable-gambits.name: Riposte
cheat.honorable-gambits.text: When you Defend against a melee attacker, you may immediately make an Opportunity Attack against them.
cheat.honorable-gambits.manualNote: After you Defend against a melee attacker, roll an Opportunity Attack against them.

cheat.honorable-gambits.name: Say That to My Face!
cheat.honorable-gambits.text: Action: (Reach 12) “Teleport” adjacent to a Taunted enemy.

action.name: Say That to My Face!
action.text: Action: (Reach 12) “Teleport” adjacent to a Taunted enemy.

cheat.honorable-gambits.manualNote: Move your token adjacent to the Taunted enemy.

cheat.honorable-gambits.name: Victor’s Confidence
cheat.honorable-gambits.text: When you kill a Taunted enemy, give an ally advantage on their next attack.
cheat.honorable-gambits.manualNote: When you kill a Taunted enemy, tell an ally they have advantage on their next attack.
